name: Ian Stewart
description: '''Ian Andrew Robert Stewart''' (18 July 1938 – 12 December 1985) was a Scottish keyboardist and co-founder of [[the Rolling Stones]]. He was removed from the lineup in May 1963 at the request of manager [[Andrew Loog Oldham]] who felt he did not fit the band's image. He remained as [[road manager]] and pianist for over two decades until his death, and was posthumously inducted into the [[Rock and Roll Hall of Fame]] along with the rest of the band in 1989.
